The Fugitive Game: Online with Kevin Mitnick is a 1996 non-fiction book by American journalist Jonathan Littman . The book chronicles the life of computer hacker Kevin Mitnick during the period when he was a fugitive from United States law enforcement authorities between 1992 and 1995. Drawing on more than fifty hours of telephone conversations with Mitnick while he was in hiding, the book presents Mitnick's account of the events that led to his pursuit and eventual arrest. [ 1 ]

...

Littman began researching the world of computer hackers and security experts around 1994. His work intersected with the high-profile pursuit of Mitnick, who had become a media sensation following front-page stories in The New York Times . Through phone interviews conducted while Mitnick was still on the run, Littman gained direct access to the fugitive's side of the story, including details
